# Logistics Domain Glossary

A **Material** is a stocked part with a unique code (format MTL-NNNN)
and a unit cost.

A **Station** is a workshop location where operations happen.

A **WarehouseLocation** is where materials are stored. The MD_ prefix
denotes master data; BO_ denotes business objects; BW_ denotes
business warehouse facts.

A **DeliveryTask** records a single shipment of a material out of the
warehouse, with quantity and status.
